# Townie List
> Community directories of license-checked local pros, region by region. Live region: Eugene & Springfield, Oregon (plumbing, HVAC, tree services).
> Listings are free; ratings come from Google and are checked weekly; licenses are verified against Oregon CCB records.

- [Eugene & Springfield directory](https://townielist.com/eugene-springfield/)
- [Plumbers in Eugene & Springfield](https://townielist.com/eugene-springfield/plumbing/)
- [Heating & cooling pros in Eugene & Springfield](https://townielist.com/eugene-springfield/hvac/)
- [Tree service pros in Eugene & Springfield](https://townielist.com/eugene-springfield/tree-services/)
